# Fizz cookbook

Twenty things producers do, each as a complete track that passes `fizz check`. Copy the construct, not the whole track.

## 1. Swing

How: `swing 0.33`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 92
key F major
swing 0.33

section "groove" bars=4
  chords: I:2 vi:2
  kick kit_bd : x... ..x. x... ....
  snare kit_sd : .... x... .... x...
  hat kit_hh : x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
  bass finger_bass : x... ..x. x... ..x.
```

## 2. Ghost notes

How: `g`, `X`, `3?`, `1!`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 96
key E dorian
swing 0.15

section "pocket" bars=4
  chords: i7:2 IV7:2
  kick kit_bd : x... ..x. ..x. ....
  snare kit_sd : .g.. X..g .g.g X.g.
  hat kit_hh : x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
  lead clav :
    1| 1 . 3? . 5 . 3? . 1! . . . . . . .
    2| 4 . 6? . 1' . 6? . 4! . . . . . . .
```

## 3. Fill every 4 bars

How: one bar per line, `r` rolls

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 120
key A minor

section "verse" bars=16
  chords: i:2 VI:2 III:2 VII:2
  kick 909_bd : x... x... x... x...
  snare 909_sd :
    1| .... x... .... x...
    2| .... x... .... x...
    3| .... x... .... x...
    4| .... x..x .x.r rrrr
  hat 909_hh : x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
```

## 4. Polyrhythm

How: `steps=12` against 16

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 110
key D minor

section "poly" bars=4
  chords: i:2 VII:2
  kick kit_bd : x... x... x... x...
  hat#shaker perc_sh steps=12 : x.x x.x x.x x.x
  lead marimba steps=12 : 1 . 3 5 . 1' 5 . 3 1 . .
```

## 5. Triplet fill in a straight bar

How: `snare#fill steps=24 enter=4 exit=4`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 100
key C major

section "verse" bars=4
  chords: I vi IV V
  kick kit_bd : x... ..x. x... ....
  snare kit_sd exit=3 : .... x... .... x...
  snare#fill kit_sd steps=24 enter=4 exit=4 : ...... ...... x.x.x. xxxxxx
  hat kit_hh : x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
```

## 6. Humanize

How: `humanize=`, `seed`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 78
key Bb major
seed 7

section "keys" bars=4
  chords: Imaj7:2 vi7:2
  chords epiano humanize=0.4 : x... ..x. .x.. x...
  bass upright_bass humanize=0.2 : 1 . . . 5, . . . 1 . 3 . 5 . . .
  hat kit_hh humanize=0.5 : x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
```

```fizz

key C major

  chords: I V/3 vi IV
  pad warm_pad voicing=led : x___ ____ ____ ____
  chords piano voicing=open : x... ..x. .... x...
  bass finger_bass : x... .... x... ....
```


## 11. Call and response

How: `lead#call`, `lead#answer`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 104
key F minor

section "trade" bars=4
  chords: i:2 iv:2
  kick 909_bd : x... x... x... x...
  lead#call brass : 5 . 3 . 1 . . . . . . . . . . . | . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
  lead#answer clav : . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . | 3 . 5 . 6 . . . . . . . . . . .
```

## 12. Motif variation

How: `phrase hook`, `$hook+3`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 118
key E minor

phrase hook = 1 . 3 5 1' _ 5 _

section "lead" bars=4
  chords: i iv VI V
  lead#hook square_lead :
    1| $hook $hook
    2| $hook+3 $hook+3
    3| $hook+5 $hook+5
    4| $hook+4 . . . . . . . .
```

## 13. Slides

How: `~5`, `glide=`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 126
key A minor

section "acid" bars=4
  chords: i:4
  kick 909_bd : x... x... x... x...
  bass sawtooth glide=0.08 : 1 . ~5 . 1' . ~1 . 1 ~b3 . 1 ~5 . ~1' .
```

## 14. Intro / verse / drop

How: `form:`, `from=`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 124
key A minor

form: intro verse drop

section intro bars=4
  chords: i:2 VI:2
  pad warm_pad : x___ ____ ____ ____

section verse bars=8
  chords: i:2 VI:2 III:2 VII:2
  kick 909_bd : x... x... x... x...
  hat 909_hh : ..x. ..x. ..x. ..x.
  bass analog_bass : x..x ..x. x... x.x.

section drop from=verse
  clap 909_cp : .... x... .... x...
  lead saw_lead : 5 . . 3 . . 1 . . . . . . . . .
```

## 15. Build-up

How: `ramp=gain,…`, `ramp=hpf,…`

```fizz
fizz score v1
bpm 128
key F minor

section "build" bars=4
  chords: i VI III VII
  snare 909_sd ramp=gain,0.3,1 :
    1| x... x... x... x...
    2| x.x. x.x. x.x. x.x.
    3| xxxx xxxx xxxx xxxx
    4| rrrr rrrr rrrr rrrr
  pad synth_strings ramp=hpf,200,3000 : x___ ____ ____ ____
```

## 20. Sidechain feel

How: `mix club`; no depth/target control

```fizz

bpm 124
key A minor
mix club

section "pump" bars=4
  chords: i:2 VI:2
  kick 909_bd : x... x... x... x...
  pad warm_pad lfo=gain,0.3,0.8,0.25 : x___ ____ ____ ____
  bass analog_bass : ..x. ..x. ..x. ..x.
```
